readout.purpose: Unbounded numerals: prizes, balances, big counts.

label.purpose: Buttons, chips, slider and nav labels.

shadows.name: pop-coral
shadows.purpose: Record-light glow under the one primary action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one coral action per screen, with the record-light glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.57 0.2 25); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; font: 700 14px Rubik, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -6px oklch(0.57 0.2 25 / 0.55); transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.17 27); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions on the dark ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: oklch(0.25 0.016 280); color: oklch(0.965 0.006 85); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; font: 600 14px Rubik, sans-serif; transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: oklch(0.29 0.016 280); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.17 27); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter and option pills; coral when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: oklch(0.25 0.016 280); color: oklch(0.74 0.016 275); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 12px Rubik, sans-serif; } .ds-chip--on { background: oklch(0.57 0.2 25); color: #fff; }

components.name: Studio Panel
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.205 0.016 280); color: oklch(0.965 0.006 85); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 22px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 10px 28px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55); font: 14px Rubik, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { color: oklch(0.74 0.016 275); margin: 6px 0 0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.25 0.016 280 / 0.6); color: oklch(0.965 0.006 85); border: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); border-radius: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; font: 14px Rubik, sans-serif; width: 260px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.74 0.016 275); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.7 0.17 27); }

components.name: Studio Slider
components.description: Scroll-safe value row: label, mono marigold value, coral fill.
components.html: Reverb12
components.css: .ds-slider { width: 280px; font: 12px Rubik, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.965 0.006 85); } .ds-slider__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-slider__val { font-family: Unbounded, Rubik, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.82 0.15 88); } .ds-slider__track { position: relative; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.25 0.016 280); } .ds-slider__fill { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: oklch(0.57 0.2 25); } .ds-slider__thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: -10px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Five slots, marigold active item, raised coral create button.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); align-items: end; width: 340px; padding: 8px; background: oklch(0.205 0.016 280 / 0.82); border-top: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.09); font: 500 10px Rubik, sans-serif; color: oklch(0.74 0.016 275); text-align: center; } .ds-nav__on { color: oklch(0.82 0.15 88); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav__create { justify-self: center; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-top: -24px; border-radius: 26px; background: oklch(0.57 0.2 25); color: #fff; font-size: 28px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -6px oklch(0.57 0.2 25 / 0.55); }

narrative.overview: Studio26 feels like a recording room after dark. The surfaces are near-black with a faint violet cast, the panels look like gear racks lit from inside, and the color sits where the signal is: a coral record light, a marigold meter needle, and an indigo or teal cue light. It matches the logo, which is black, chrome, and neon. The UI is dark-only, by the owner's decision on 2026-10-16. There is no light mode, and none should be added.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only ground with violet-tinted neutrals (hue 275–280), never pure black or grey.
Coral is the action and "on air" color, and marigold is the active, selected, or value color.
Firm corners: 12px buttons, 22px panels, pills only for chips and tags; a hairline white border at 9% opacity.
Rubik for every word in every script; Unbounded only for numeric readouts (prizes, coins, counts).
The level meter (gold body, coral peak) is the signature motif.
Exponential settle on touch (`--ease-snappy`), no bounce.

rules.name: The Two-Shade Rule
rules.body: Colored text uses the text shades (`text-brand-coral`, `text-brand-indigo`, `text-brand-teal`, `text-danger`). Never use core `text-primary` or `text-destructive`, because those are the fill shades and fail contrast on the dark ground. Every text/fill pair must reach WCAG AA 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Gold Label Rule
rules.body: Anything filled with marigold takes the dark marigold-ink label. White on gold is never allowed.

rules.name: The Arabic Joining Rule
rules.body: Arabic text gets no letter-spacing, ever. `:lang(ar)` resets it globally, so don't fight that reset.

rules.name: The Bidi Rule
rules.body: User-written text (titles, bios, comments, handles, messages) gets `bidi-auto`, so its own direction wins inside an RTL or LTR page.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Only the primary action on a screen gets the coral glow.

rules.name: The Scroll-Safe Control Rule
rules.body: Any control that sits inside a scrolling list and changes a value (sliders, steppers, toggles in long panels) must not react to a touch that starts a scroll. Value controls on touch begin only after intent is clear: a horizontal drag past a small threshold. Never use a bare `<input type="range">` in a scrolling panel on mobile.

dos: Do pair every fill with its matching label shade (white on coral, indigo, or teal; marigold-ink on marigold).
Do use the text shades for colored text on the dark ground.
Do give the primary action on a screen the coral fill and glow, and only that one.
Do use logical spacing and `text-start` so layouts mirror in RTL.
Do set prizes, balances and big counts in Unbounded (`font-numeric`) so they scan as instruments.
Do group list rows into one `list-group` panel.
donts: Don't add a light theme or light surfaces.
Don't stack look-alike cards for list items, or decorate with blurred colour blobs and floating icons.
Don't show a fake waveform: draw the take's real envelope or nothing.
Don't put white text on marigold.
Don't let a value control change on a scroll gesture or an accidental tap.
Don't invent social proof (counts, testimonials, label logos). Studio26 is pre-launch.
